content_sections.heading: ANGRAU Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: The official notification gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download ANGRAU notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Ph.D. in the relevant subject; or Master's Degree in relevant subject; Bachelor's Degree of 4/5 years having first division or equivalent overall grade point average; Published one research paper in Science Citation Index (SCI)/ NAAS rated ≥4.0 journals; Candidates having post graduate degree in Basic sciences with 3 years Bachelor's degree and 2 years Master's degree should have the NET qualification Experience: At least 3 years of respective teaching / research experience as evidenced from Fellowship/Associateship/Training/other engagements Age limit: Maximum 40 years for Men, 45 years for Women Age relaxation: Women Upper age limit 45 years Other conditions: Selected candidate must undergo medical examination at own expense before appointment

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: HRA as per existing State Government rates applicable in various places/locations, subject to change as per Government orders. Purely temporary, contractual basis, not exceeding 11 months Ends automatically after 11 months or filling of regular post, whichever is earlier No claim to regular appointment or further continuation of contractual service Engagement can be terminated at any time without prior notice or reason Engaged person may leave by giving one-month notice, otherwise pay one-month salary

content_sections.heading: How Will ANGRAU Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Walk-in interview by selection committee Decision of the selection committee is final and binding Concealing of facts or canvassing leads to disqualification

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Filled-in application All original certificates One set of photocopies of all certificates Publications Any other relevant documents

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ANGRAU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Register name before 9.30 AM on 05.12.2026 at the Office of the Associate Dean, Agricultural College, Naira. Bring a filled-in application. Bring all original certificates and one set of photocopies of all certificates, publications and other relevant documents. Attend the interview at 10.30 AM on 05.12.2026 at Agricultural College, Naira, Srikakulam (Dist.).

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No T.A & D.A for candidates appearing for interview Associate Dean may cancel or postpone the interview due to unavoidable circumstances Contact: [email protected] , Mobile 7673902146

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for ANGRAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ANGRAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Teaching Associate (Crop Physiology).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ANGRAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 5 December 2026. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 40 years for Men, 45 years for Women. Relaxation: Women Upper age limit 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 61,000 per month + HRA (Master's Degree holders); Rs. 67,000 per month + HRA (Ph.D degree holders).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Ph.D. in the relevant subject or Master's Degree in relevant subject; Bachelor's Degree of 4/5 years with first division or equivalent OGPA; at least 3 years of teaching/research experience; one research paper in SCI/NAAS rated ≥4.0 journals; NET for PG in Basic sciences with 3-year Bachelor's and 2-year Master's.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Selected candidate must undergo medical examination at own expense before appointment.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview by selection committee. Decision of the selection committee is final and binding. Concealing of facts or canvassing leads to disqualification.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely temporary, contractual basis, not exceeding 11 months. Ends automatically after 11 months or filling of regular post, whichever is earlier. No claim to regular appointment or further continuation of contractual service.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Agricultural College, Naira, Srikakulam (Dist.).
